data.sql: SELECT to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City','YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia

SELECT id,cliente_id,tipo,importe::text,
  movimiento_origen_id,md5(to_jsonb(m)::text) AS huella_fila,
  to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS fecha_mexico
  FROM movimientos_credito m WHERE cliente_id IN (6,7) ORDER BY id

WITH p(abono,cargo,recaptura) AS
    (VALUES (46,43,'2026-09-15T13:35:17.006-06:00'::timestamptz),
            (45,44,'2026-09-15T13:34:10.192-06:00'::timestamptz))
    SELECT p.abono,p.cargo,a.importe::text,a.forma_pago,a.cuenta_destino,
    to_char(p.recaptura AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS recaptura_mexico,
    to_char(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS.US') AS cargo_mexico,
    extract(epoch FROM p.recaptura-c.created_at)::text AS diferencia_segundos,
    p.recaptura=(a.metadata::jsonb->>'fechaCaptura')::timestamptz AS coincide_captura,
    c.metadata::jsonb->>'preventImplicitFavor' AS veto
    FROM p JOIN movimientos_credito a ON a.id=p.abono
    JOIN movimientos_credito c ON c.id=p.cargo ORDER BY p.abono DESC
